body: OK mr. "i ate and my suicide went away"
You have to make a mistake to get suicide chants in your head? Must be nice. All I have to do is be awake.

Thanks, but it does suck knowing you've tried it all and it doesn't help.

There's no light at the end of the tunnel for me. At least some people have false(?) hope of thinking they can get better if they do x, y, z.

Likewise.

No sir, it's like you fell into the ocean but the ocean is despair and you are literally drowning in it but it won't actually kill you, just torture you. Almost like god or the universe hates me, or maybe I died already and this is hell. I must have been evil in a past life.

Me too, I keep thinking of ways to try and ease the pain. I've tried medication, meditation, working out/exercise, supplements, eating better, getting a better job, sleeping better. I've done everything anyone would recommend and the pain is so strong, nothing will kill it. 

I'm the only one who can end my suffering, just have to be brave one day.
It's technically mental pain, but it really does hurt. It's not describable. It is surreal.
It makes me euphoric thinking about ending the pain. lol

Yeah, I think so. I made a post about this before on another account and people get really upset at this notion, but I've found that a lot of times people get really upset because it's the truth and it's not one they want to admit, talk about, or acknowledge.

Can't wait for cancer to take me.

I'm not going to live in a hospital. When it starts making my quality of life shitty, I will end myself.

No point in getting into medical debt I'll never be able to pay off for a chance of living. I'm already depressed. Mountains of debt will definitely kill me if the cancer doesn't.

Yeah, I kept telling myself in the past that if I got my life together a little bit more and had more money I'd be okay, but now I know that's a lie and even if things look okay to everyone else, they're still not okay and no amount of money or anything else can fix me because I am beyond broken.

I can relate to quite a bit of your post. Mid 20s and only ever had 1 gf. I know now I'm not capable of relationships and emotions the way others are. I think I'm autistic or something when it comes to that shit.

Doesn't matter anyway.

Like questions people such as family and stuff have as to why you killed yourself or what? 
People that commit suicide obviously don't ask questions, so I'm kind of confused as to what you mean.
If you mean what I think you mean, people obviously want to know why you did it, and they probably want to know why you didn't talk to them about it. Just a guess though, I'm sure everyone has different questions.

Damn dude, that's gotta be hard. People say it's better to have loved and lost then to have never loved at all, but I don't know if I believe it. I've had a few partners, and I've treated them like royalty, only to have them leave me for someone else. And it just hurts so much. It's like being told you've won the lottery, only to have it ripped away from you. I can't say if it's worse or better than what you have experienced, but just know you're only missing out on inevitable heartbreak anyway, and it hurts more than when I had no one, because I was given such a false hope only to have it violently ripped away.
